passages.text:
# Archival transcript
Written January 23, 1847.
Arun Moss wrote the museum catalogue.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
Inventory leaf 2. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
Inventory leaf 3. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
